```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(ggpubr)

#install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)


#install.packages("DiagrammeR")
#install.packages("DiagrammeRsvg")

library(DiagrammeR)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(rsvg)
```

#Figure 2
```{r}
F2A <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions,
          truth = Single_outcome_SVN,
          .pred_Healthy)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(lty = "dashed", color = "gray", size = 1.5) +
  geom_path(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = panel_labels_maternal,
            aes(x = .4, y = .2, label = "Auc = 0.653"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw()

#Auc = 0.653


F2B <- ggplot(importance_tax_SVN, aes(x = rank, y = cumulative_importance)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Top Variables",
    y = "Cumulative Importance",
    title = "Cumulative Variable Importance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


F2C <- ggplot(SVN_plot_importance_tax_SVN[1:23,], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(TaxLabel, Importance), fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Importance", 
       y = "Top 23 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)", 
       title = "ASVs by Importance")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",  axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", color = "black", face = "bold"))



F2D <- ggplot(SVN_plot_df_tax_SVN, aes(x = reorder(TaxLabel, Difference), y = Difference, fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), hjust = ifelse(SVN_plot_df_tax_SVN$Difference > 0, -0.2, 1.2)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Microbiome Relative Abundance",
       x = "Top 23 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)",
       y = "Difference in Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", color = "black", face = "bold"))


Figure2 <- (F2A + F2B) / free(F2C, side = "l") / free(F2D, side = "l") + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')


print(Figure2)

ggsave("Figure2_plot.png", Figure2, width = 7, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  

```








#Figure 3
```{r}

F3A <- ggplot(ROC_maternal, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(lty = "dashed", color = "gray", size = 1.5, ) +
  geom_path(aes(), size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 1) +
    geom_text(data = panel_labels_maternal,
            aes(x = .25, y = .2, label = label, size = .1),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
F3B <- ggplot(AGP_plot_df_tax_AGP, aes(x = reorder(TaxLabel, Difference), y = Difference, fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), hjust = ifelse(AGP_plot_df_tax_AGP$Difference > 0, -0.2, 1.2)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Elevated AGP",
       x = "Top 30 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)",
       y = "Difference in Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", color = "black", face = "bold"))

F3C <- ggplot(cal_plot_df_tax_cal, aes(x = reorder(TaxLabel, Difference), y = Difference, fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), hjust = ifelse(cal_plot_df_tax_cal$Difference > 0, -0.2, 1.2)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Elevated Calprotectin",
       x = "Top 21 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)",
       y = "Difference in Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", color = "black", face = "bold"))

designF3 <- c(
area(1, 1, 5, 1),
area(1, 2, 3, 3),
area(4, 2, 5, 3))

Figure3 <- F3A + F3B + F3C + 
  plot_layout(design = designF3) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
print(Figure3)

ggsave("Figure3_plot.png", Figure3, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)

```







#Figure 4
```{r}


F4 <- ggplot(ROC_SVN, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(lty = "dashed", color = "gray", size = 1.5) +
  geom_path(aes(), size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 3) +
  geom_text(data = panel_labels_SVN,
            aes(x = .4, y = .2, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")



Figure4 <- ggarrange(
  F4
)


print(Figure4)

ggsave("Figure4_plot.png", Figure4, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)

```




# Figure 1
```{r}


F1 <- grViz("
digraph consort {
  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]
  
  node [shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = LightGray, fixedsize=false, fontsize=10,]

  A [label = '  Participants enrolled in registry (n = 1637)  ']
  B [label = '  Randomly selected in first trimester (n = 463)  ']
  C [label = '  Provided blood samples (n = 416)  ']
  
  D [label = '  Birth outcomes recorded (n = 385)  ']
  D2 [label = '  Lost to follow up (n = 31)  ']
  
  E [label = '  Fecal samples sequenced (n = 367)  ']
  E2 [label = '  Fecal samples not collected (n = 18)  ']
  
  F [label = '  Retained after DADA2 pipeline (n = 237)  ']
  F2 [label = '  Excluded for sequencing quality  \\n-   Filtered reads <65% input reads  \\n-   Assigned ASVs <50% input reads  \\n   or   \\n-   <20,000 input reads (n = 131) ']
  
  G [label = '  Samples included in analysis (n = 213)  ']
  G2 [label = '  Exclusion due to birth outcome  \\n-   Twins (n = 2)  \\n-   Miscarriage (n = 16)  \\n-   Medically terminated pregnancy (n = 1)  \\n-   Still birth (n = 5)  ']
  
  H [label = '  Non-SVN (n = 107)  ']
  H2 [label = '  SVN (n = 106)  ']

  A -> B
  B -> C
  C -> D
  C -> D2 [dir=none, constraint=false]
  D -> E
  D -> E2 [dir=none, constraint=false]
  E -> F
  E -> F2 [dir=none, constraint=false]
  F -> G
  F -> G2 [dir=none, constraint=false]
  G -> H
  G -> H2 
  
  // Rank same for side-by-side appearance
{rank = same; C; D2}
{rank = same; D; E2}
{rank = same; E; F2}
{rank = same; F; G2}
}
")



Figure1 <- export_svg(F1)


rsvg_png(charToRaw(Figure1), "Figure1_diagram_revised.png", width = 2400, height = 3600)


```



#Figure S3
```{r}

FS3A <- ggplot(sample_data_2, aes(x = Single_outcome_SVN, y = Observed, color = Single_outcome_SVN)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Healthy" = "Non-SVN",
                              "SVN" = "SVN")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed", title = "Microbial Richness") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
   stat_compare_means(aes(), label.x = 1.5, label.y = 20)
  
FS3B <- ggplot(sample_data_2, aes(x = Single_outcome_SVN, y = pielou, color = Single_outcome_SVN)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Healthy" = "Non-SVN",
                              "SVN" = "SVN")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pielou Evenness Index", title = "Microbial Evenness") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
   stat_compare_means(aes(), label.x = 1.5, label.y = 0.4)

FS3C <- ordplot_bray +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = c("Healthy" = "Non-SVN",
                                  "SVN" = "SVN")) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_fixed() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = -1.25, label = "p = 0.042", color = "black")
  
FS3D <- taxa_relabun_2_p %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Healthy" = "Non-SVN",
                              "SVN" = "SVN")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw()+
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance", title = "Phylum Relative Abundance")
  
FS3E <- ggplot(data = taxa_relabun_1, aes(x = Single_outcome_SVN, y = Abundance)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape  = NA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Healthy" = "Non-SVN",
                              "SVN" = "SVN")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Single_outcome_SVN), height = 0, width = .2) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Abundance\n") +
  facet_wrap(~ Family, scales = "free")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank())
  

FigureS3 <- (FS3A + FS3B) / (FS3C + FS3D) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')


print(FigureS3)

ggsave("FigureS3_plot_revised.png", FigureS3, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)


```


#Figure S2

```{r}

FS2A <- ggplot(importance_tax_AGP, aes(x = rank, y = cumulative_importance)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Top Variables",
    y = "Cumulative Importance",
    title = "Cumulative Importance (AGP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
FS2B <- ggplot(AGP_plot_importance_tax_AGP[1:30,], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(TaxLabel, Importance), fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Importance", 
       y = "Top 30 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)", 
       title = "AGP: ASVs by Importance")+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", color = "black", face = "bold"))
  
  
FS2C <- ggplot(importance_tax_cal, aes(x = rank, y = cumulative_importance)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Top Variables",
    y = "Cumulative Importance",
    title = "Cumulative Importance (Calprotectin)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
FS2D <- ggplot(cal_plot_importance_tax_cal[1:21,], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(TaxLabel, Importance), fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Importance", 
       y = "Top 21 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)", 
       title = "Calprotectin: ASVs by Importance")+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", color = "black", face = "bold"))
  


FigureS2 <- (FS2A + FS2B) / (FS2C + FS2D) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')


print(FigureS2)

ggsave("FigureS2_plot.png", FigureS2, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
